ferme_charbonneaux.name: La ferme des Légumes Charbonneaux
ferme_charbonneaux.description: ne ferme, dirige par Thomas Charbonneaux, où on peut trouver de savoureux et juteux légumes

ferme_uzoloise.name: La ferme Royale
ferme_uzoloise.description: La ferme royale de la principaute d'Uzols, où on peut trouver de la viande de qualité

fontaneilles.name: Capitale du roquefort
fontaneilles.description: Une ville qui sent étonnement fort le fromage

merchant_tent.name: Merchant's Tent
merchant_tent.description: A colorful canvas sheltering all sorts of tools and seeds. It smells of incense and old parchment.

old_barn.name: Old Barn
old_barn.description: A weathered wooden barn with hay spilling from its loft. Chickens cluck softly somewhere inside.

chicken_coop.name: Chicken Coop
chicken_coop.description: A cozy fenced coop with a little thatched roof. Fluffy hens waddle about, and one nest gleams faintly.

north_bridge.name: Wooden Bridge
north_bridge.description: A sturdy plank bridge creaks gently over a clear stream. Dragonflies dart between the railings.

windmill.name: Windmill Yard
windmill.description: A tall windmill turns lazily against the sky, its wooden gears groaning with every rotation.

forest_edge.name: Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: Tall pines mark the border of the wild woods. Something large rustles in the undergrowth ahead.

riverside.name: Riverside Path
riverside.description: A gentle path hugging the riverbank, dotted with pink wildflowers and half-submerged stepping stones.

fishing_dock.name: Fishing Dock
fishing_dock.description: A small wooden dock stretches over calm turquoise water, lined with crates and coiled rope.

orchard.name: Blossom Orchard
orchard.description: Rows of blossoming trees sway overhead, petals drifting down onto soft grass like pink snow.

mais_sucre.name: Maïs sucré
mais_sucre.description: Du mais si sucre qu on dirait une glace

crisp_apple.name: Crisp Apple
crisp_apple.description: A ripe red apple fallen from a nearby tree. Restores a bit of health.

leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
leather_boots.description: Old farmer's boots. They give you more confidence and a slight shield.

gold_acorn.name: Gold Acorn
gold_acorn.description: The local currency. Gleams with a magical shine.

rusty_hoe.name: Rusty Hoe
rusty_hoe.description: An old farming tool. Not great for tilling, but it can serve as a makeshift weapon.

pitchfork.name: Farmer's Pitchfork
pitchfork.description: A sturdy pitchfork with iron prongs. Perfect for fending off pests.

watering_can.name: Watering Can
watering_can.description: A dented tin watering can. Swung hard enough, it makes a decent improvised weapon.

golden_egg.name: Golden Egg
golden_egg.description: A suspiciously shiny egg laid by one of the coop's hens. Shepherd Hana would love to see this.

wheat_bundle.name: Wheat Bundle
wheat_bundle.description: A neatly tied bundle of golden wheat stalks, ready for the mill.

blueberry_basket.name: Blueberry Basket
blueberry_basket.description: A small woven basket filled with plump, freshly picked blueberries. Restores health.

old_fishing_rod.name: Old Fishing Rod
old_fishing_rod.description: A worn bamboo fishing rod. The hook end is surprisingly sharp when swung.

wool_scarf.name: Wool Scarf
wool_scarf.description: A thick, hand-knit scarf. Wrapping it around you offers a bit of protection from the cold and from claws.

windmill_gear.name: Windmill Gear
windmill_gear.description: A heavy wooden cog fallen from the windmill's mechanism. Miller Greta might want it back.

golden_shears.name: Golden Shears
golden_shears.description: Ornate shears with a gilded edge, awarded to those brave enough to drive off the forest boar.

thomas_charbonneaux.name: Thomas Charbonneaux
thomas_charbonneaux.description: Le patron de la ferme des Légumes Charbonneaux
dialogue: Salut salut
Tabarouette
J'ai panier quelqu chose de gros ...
Tabarouette, il nous reste encore du mais sucré
Passez nous voir au 133 chemin du Vide à Sainte-Angèle-de-Monnoir

le_prince.name: Le Prince
le_prince.description: Le prince Uzolois, il est TRÈS fier de sa ferme
dialogue: Approchez approchez voyons ...
Regardez moi comment elle est belle cette Salers
QUOIIII !!!
VOUS OSEZ DIRE QU'ELLE N'EN VAUT PAS LE COUT ???
Me dire ca a MOII ? Le PRINCEEEE !!!

paco.name: Paco le Corbeau
paco.description: Paco raffole, du mais, surtout s'il est sucré
dialogue: *Caw!* (Il se jette sur toi en picorant à tout va !)
*CAWWWWW!!!*

gabinap.name: HardcoreLevelingWarrior
gabinap.description: Un jeune palefrenier qui flex en calisthenie
dialogue: DAMNNNN
Tema le bibiii !!!
Ushh ushh
Allez viens que je te battes en pompes

shepherd_hana.name: Shepherd Hana
shepherd_hana.description: A gentle coop-keeper who dotes on every hen by name.
dialogue: One of my hens laid the strangest golden egg this morning!
Could you fetch it for me? I'm too short to reach the top nest.

feral_boar.name: Feral Boar
feral_boar.description: A hulking, tusked boar that has been trampling crops near the forest edge.
dialogue: *Snort!* (It stomps the ground and lowers its tusks!)

fisherman_jed.name: Fisherman Jed
fisherman_jed.description: A weathered old fisherman who hasn't left the dock in years, or so the rumor goes.
dialogue: Quiet waters today. Good for thinking, bad for fishing.
Mind the crates, some of them bite back.

effraye_paco.description: Effraye Paco le corbeau pour qu'il arrete de manger tout le mais sucre

spring_harvest.description: Find a Turnip Seed on the Overgrown Path and bring it to Fiona.

golden_egg_hunt.description: Find the Golden Egg in the Chicken Coop and bring it back to Shepherd Hana.

cull_the_boar.description: Defeat the Feral Boar terrorizing the Forest Edge to protect the nearby crops.
